title: Artificial Intelligence to take centerstage at 49th ASEAN Summit
summary: Artificial intelligence is expected to take centerstage in discussions at the upcoming ASEAN Summit, as Southeast Asian leaders seek to strengthen regional cooperation amid global uncertainties.
